1) Enable the switch. 2) Open the page detector and press Play. 3) Come back here and Copy/Share the log. For USB inspection: enable Android USB debugging, connect to a computer, open chrome://inspect/#devices in Chrome, inspect Xtr3, and watch Network/Media.
Logs redact common token/password fields, but may still contain page text and media URLs. Share only with people you trust.
